data: Which algorithm has the highest reward in Env. 4 after 4000 training dialogues?

The question asks which algorithm has the highest reward in Env. 4 after 4000 training dialogues. From the caption, we know that the figure compares learning curves for Feudal-DQN and DIP-DQN in Env. 4, along with the two best performing algorithms in (Casanueva et al., 2017), DQN and GP-Sarsa. 

Looking at the graph, we can see that the blue line (Feudal-DQN) is consistently above the other lines throughout the training dialogue range. At 4000 training dialogues, the blue line (Feudal-DQN) appears to have the highest reward among all the algorithms shown. Therefore, the answer is Feudal-DQN.
